en-US.description: A third-party desktop client for OMP (oh-my-pi) with the PiUI visual shell and the official OMP RPC runtime.
en-US.longDescription:
OMPiUI is a third-party web/desktop client for OMP (oh-my-pi): the interface reuses the PiUI visual shell, while agent execution is powered by the official oh-my-pi (OMP) RPC runtime with 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, a sub-agent system, MCP/LSP, and extensions.
The interface comes from lehhair's PiUI and OpenCodeUI. OMPiUI is not an official client of either project.
It requires Node 22.19 or later and the OMP CLI (18.2.11 or later, installed with bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent), with provider credentials configured.

zh-CN.description: OMP（oh-my-pi）的第三方桌面客户端，采用 PiUI 视觉外壳与 OMP 官方 RPC 运行时。
zh-CN.longDescription:
OMPiUI 是 OMP（oh-my-pi）的第三方 Web/桌面客户端：界面沿用 PiUI 的视觉外壳，agent 执行由 oh-my-pi（OMP）的官方 RPC 运行时承担，提供 60+ provider、31 个内置工具、子代理系统、MCP/LSP 和扩展支持。
界面来自 lehhair 的 PiUI 与 OpenCodeUI。OMPiUI 不是这两个项目的官方客户端。
使用前需要安装 Node ≥ 22.19 与 OMP CLI（≥ 18.2.11，通过 bun install -g @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent 安装），并配置 provider 凭据。
